title: Integrating MBSE Principles with AI to Improve the Quality of Requirements in SMEs Context
abstract: arXiv:2611.09234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is a promising approach to improve systems engineering practices, particularly by enhancing requirement management, traceability, and early validation and verification (V\&V). However, its adoption remains challenging, especially for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which often lack structured processes and solutions adapted to their scale and constraints. Our goal is to propose a lightweight MBSE methodology tailored to the needs and constraints of SMEs. This paper focuses specifically on requirements refinement, traceability, and early V\&V. The approach integrates MBSE principles with artificial intelligence-assisted analysis to improve requirements quality while remaining compatible with existing tools and practices. A proof of concept is developed and applied in an industrial case study to evaluate the feasibility of the approach. The results demonstrate how early V\&V activities can

translated_title: 在中小企业背景下融合MBSE原则与人工智能以提升需求质量
translated_abstract: 模型化系统工程（MBSE）是一种有望改善系统工程实践的方法，尤其体现在增强需求管理、可追溯性以及早期验证与确认（V&V）方面。然而，其推广应用仍然面临挑战，特别是对于中小型企业（SMEs）而言，它们通常缺乏结构化的流程以及适应其规模和约束条件的解决方案。我们的目标是提出一种轻量级的MBSE方法，以契合中小企业的需求与约束。本文特别关注需求细化、可追溯性以及早期验证与确认。该方法将MBSE原则与人工智能辅助分析相结合，在提升需求质量的同时保持与现有工具和实践的兼容性。研究开发了一个概念验证方案，并将其应用于一个工业案例研究中，以评估该方法的可行性。研究结果表明，早期V&V活动可以（原文摘要到此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合AI辅助分析的轻量级MBSE方法，帮助中小企业在兼容现有工具的前提下提升需求质量，实现需求细化、可追溯性与早期验证确认。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight MBSE methodology integrated with AI-assisted analysis, enabling SMEs to improve requirements quality through requirements refinement, traceability, and early V&V while remaining compatible with existing tools and practices.
